race.comment: MY COUNTRY BOY (4) improving entire with his hoof on the till. Third-up for this after he savaged the line with a close-up fourth over 1400m at Kembla Grange eight days ago. Maps well and he looks ready for the 1600m. Hard to beat. INDIGO STAR (1) frustrating gelding who comes back in class after warming up late to finish third over 1400m at Warwick Farm. Blinkers stay on and shapes as the main danger. DA VINCI ROSE (10) lightly raced filly looking for this trip and further now. Slow in to stride and covered plenty of ground in the run with a battling fifth over 1400m at Newcastle. Best figures measure up nicely with the senior rider jumping aboard. WHAT SHE'S HAVING (7) was left with too much to do when swinging for home at Goulburn first-up. Fitter second-up and should settle closer in smaller field. Watch for her late.
